0.1 This Indian Standard ( First R.evision ) was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution on 31 March 1987, after the draft finalized by the Pest Control Sectional Committee had been approved by the Agricultural and Food Products Division Council and tile Chemical Division Council. 0.% Quinalphos EC containing varying percentaps of quinalphos, technical, are used in the control of iDS(ctpests for alricultural crops�. 0.3 Quinalphos Be forml1latioDs areaeneraUy manufactured to contain 2' p~ rcent ( mlm ) of quinalphos. 0.4 This standard was first published in 1976. It is being revised to make its requirement up to date. 0.5 ID the preparation of this standard, due consideration bas been liven to the provisions of the 1",ectictd'8 A.(I, 1968, and the rules framed thereunder. However, this standard is subject to the restrictions imposed under these, wberever applicable. 0.6 For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this standard is complied with, tbe final value, observed or calculated, expressing the result of a test or analysj�� shall be rounded off in accordance with IS : 2�1960-. The Dumber of si.nificant plac. retained in the rounding off value should be the same as that of the Ipecified value in this standard.

REQUIREMENTS 2.1 Constituents - The material shall consist of quinalphos, technical. dissolved in suitable solvent(s), together with emulsifying agent(s), and with or without stabilizer(s). 2.1.1 QuinalphC's, technical, employed in the manufacture of this material shall conform to IS : 8072�1984�. 2.2 Phy.lcal- The material shall comply with the physical requirements specified in 2.2.1 to 2.2.4. 2.2.1 Description - The material Rhall be homogeneous and stable liquid, free from sediment. Suspended matter shall be negligible. On dilution with water it shall readily form an emulsion suitable for spray. 2.2.2 Cold Test - No turbidity or separation of solid or oily matter or both shall occur when the material is subjected to the cold test at 110�C as prescribed in 13.1 of IS: 6940�1982t or at any other lower temperature as agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier. Introduction of a seeding crystal is not necessary for the test. 2.2.3 Flash Point ( Abel) - When determined by the method prescribed in IS : 1448 [ P : 20 j.1982t, the flash point of the material shall be above 24�SoC. 2.2.4 Emulsion Stability - Any separation, including creaming at the top and sedimentation at the bottom, of 100 ml of emulsion prepared in standard hard water with S'O ml of concentrate for public health use aDd with 2'0 ml of concentrate for agricultural use, shall not exceed 2�0 ml when tested by one of the methods prescribed in 13.3 of IS : 69401982t� 2.2.5 Heat Stability - After treating in accordance with the method prescribed in 13." of IS : 6940-1982t, the material shall comply with the requirements specified in 2.2.1 to 2.2.4 and 2.3.1.
